notes: Penance is uncapped. Holy upgrades cost 20% less mana; each upgraded cost is a literal editable value in spells.json.
Oaths that forbid direct damage fail on actual enemy Health damage from a spell, not DoTs, retaliation or absorbed damage.
Oaths reward at reshuffle start, after simultaneous spell damage. New Penance during a reshuffle waits for the next one.
